name: Sexton's Toll
languages: Common plus the languages it knew in life

Traits.name: Resonant Knell
Traits.text: A creature that hits the sexton's toll with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it has the Deafened condition until the end of its next turn.
Traits.expresses: a spectral bell it strikes with its own shadow-stuff

Traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
Traits.text: The sexton's toll can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

Traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
Traits.text: While in sunlight, the sexton's toll has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The sexton's toll makes two Iron Clapper attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Discordant Peal.

Actions.name: Iron Clapper
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 5 ft. 30 (7d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage.

Actions.name: Discordant Peal
Actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 19, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* The target has the Blinded condition until the end of the sexton's toll's next turn.

lore: A sexton died with a toll unfinished, and what remains of him rings his spectral iron still, counting down to the grave he was denied.

unplaced.text: The bell's clapper strikes again, and the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against {dc} or take {dmg} Necrotic damage as the peal reaches down the road no one walks back.

generation.userConcept: a bell-wraith that tolls once for fear, twice for sleep, and three times for the grave
generation.cite: composition after Wraith (CR 5) — Life Drain under the sunlight bane

immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained
monsterDescription: a bell-wraith that tolls once for fear, twice for sleep, and three times for the grave
